notes:
v0.3.36 - the memory figures correct themselves properly now

Follow-up to 0.3.35. After one real load, the screen was still using the
disproved arithmetic to work out the OTHER context sizes - so a measured
model could show a smaller context costing less than the measurement it came
from. Sizes at or below something you have actually run are now reported from
that run, and anything above it is clearly an upper bound rather than a guess
dressed up as a figure.
